description:
## Finding

\`getrandom = { version = \"0.3\", optional = true }\` is declared
directly in crate-jmap-chat-server/Cargo.toml as a version dep,
rather than being hoisted to the workspace's
\`[workspace.dependencies]\` table and inherited via
\`getrandom = { workspace = true, optional = true }\`.

Every other dep in chat-server's Cargo.toml flows through
\`workspace = true\`. \`getrandom\` is the only outlier.

## What goes wrong

Two soft issues:

1. **Version inconsistency risk if a second crate picks up
   \`getrandom\`.** Today chat-server is the only consumer of
   \`getrandom\` in the workspace, so there is no concrete drift.
   If a future crate (e.g. a federation-token generator or a
   blob-id helper) adds \`getrandom\` and pins to a different
   minor version, cargo unification papers over the difference
   but version-tracking discipline is harder to audit.

2. **Cargo.toml audit friction.** The workspace AGENTS.md
   describes \"path-AND-version dual declaration via workspace =
   true\" as the canonical pattern. A consistency sweep across
   crates needs to special-case chat-server's getrandom line,
   which is a small maintenance tax.

## Recommendation

Hoist \`getrandom = \"0.3\"\` to
\`[workspace.dependencies]\` in the root \`Cargo.toml\`, and change
chat-server's line to \`getrandom = { workspace = true, optional = true }\`.

Zero functional impact, satisfies the consistency convention.

## Engineering basis

- Verified \`getrandom\` line in
  \`crate-jmap-chat-server/Cargo.toml\` is a direct version dep.
- Verified no \`getrandom\` entry exists in the workspace root
  \`Cargo.toml\`'s \`[workspace.dependencies]\` table (by absence;
  the workspace dep table was reviewed).
- Verified \`getrandom\` is not used by any other workspace
  crate today (sole consumer is chat-server's invite-code CSPRNG
  per the existing \`.36\` resolution).

## Priority rationale

P4 because no caller experiences this today; it's a
consistency tax that becomes a real ordering risk only when a
second crate adopts \`getrandom\`. Filing here so the consistency
sweep is visible alongside other versioning concerns.
title: API contract: getrandom is a direct (non-workspace) dep, breaks consistent [workspace.dependencies] pattern
